quotes.text: At revision f3f51b662624a5d14774cf9fe3d5def6822b77ae, the Account Hub large radio card patch intended to make the card temporarily focusable during mouse selection so accessibility click checks could see the interactive card. This is the commit's stated reason for the change, not a confirmed runtime result or a general rule for other radio cards. Recheck the current code and test behavior before applying it elsewhere.
